## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

- [ ] `cargo test --workspace --locked` passes.
- [ ] Relevant UI, daemon, hardware-backend, or Omarchy plugin checks are included.
- [ ] Hardware changes preserve automatic-control restoration and temperature failsafes.
- [ ] Describe hardware tested, or state when testing used simulated hardware.
- [ ] User-facing behavior and configuration changes are documented.
